devices.*.scenes.light_scene.label-language: Govee's scene names from the scene endpoint of the device — Govee content in one language, no fixed vocabulary the adapter could translate

groups.*.scenes.light_scene.label-language: The scene names the group's members share — Govee content in one language, no fixed vocabulary the adapter could translate

devices.*.scenes.diy_scene.label-language: The user's own DIY effect names from the Govee app — the user's text, shown as written

devices.*.snapshots.snapshot_cloud.label-language: The user's own snapshot names from the Govee app — the user's text, shown as written

devices.*.music.music_mode.label-language: Govee's music effect names (Energic, Rhythm, …) declared by the device — Govee content; a group matches its members by these names

groups.*.music.music_mode.label-language: The music effect names every member declares — Govee content; each member resolves the name against its own list

devices.*.control.nightlight_scene.label-language: Govee's night-light effect names (Flame, Rainbow, …) declared by the device — Govee content, no fixed vocabulary

$sameInEveryLanguage.DIY: Govee's kettle mode for a user-defined programme — German and the Govee app use the same abbreviation
$sameInEveryLanguage.Thermometer: Device type label — German writes the same word
$sameInEveryLanguage.Sensor: Device type label — German writes the same word
